versions.changelog:
- Initial release.
- Generates prioritized operating plans for Amazon inventory issues: stockout recovery, tight/working/excess inventory.
- Guides users to provide only relevant, changeable input data, requesting clarifications when needed.
- Diagnoses inventory states using scenario-based math and explicit coverage calculations.
- Lists actionable recommendations with risk warnings and clear operating boundaries.
- Requires human review before executing any purchase, promotion, pricing, or advertising actions.
